title: Console Onramp cardset: scope curation, fallback rules, and acceptance criteria
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: carve a minimal, high-value telemetry surface for the Console alpha (Onramp) so engineering effort focuses on stable, low-cost routes. This ticket documents scope removals, fallback behaviours, acceptance criteria, and rollout gating.

Background: multiple PM/design/eng sessions concluded current Console scope is too broad for an alpha ship. Key user needs for alpha: quick route cost snapshot, top-3 slow routes, and ability to inspect a single trace. Deep long-term features (sampling configurator, route heatmaps, full-query tracing, per-token cost breakdown) are deferred to later phases.

Progress updates:
- 2025-01-30: Align with infra: we can support a single pre-aggregated cost tile refreshed hourly; streaming trace search will be blocked for alpha.
- 2025-02-04: Design delivered compact mockups for 3-card layout (CostSummary, TopLatencyRoutes, SingleTraceInspect). Link: https://drive.redwood/company/console/onramp-design-v1
- 2025-02-06: Eng feasibility review: KV cache for trace prefixing is incompatible with alpha timeframe; propose lightweight trace sampling + record-linking instead.
- 2025-02-12: Legal sign-off for telemetry PII minimization accepted.

Trade-offs considered:
- Cost vs fidelity: hourly pre-aggregation reduces infra cost but increases data staleness — acceptable for alpha.
- Developer effort vs value: full trace search deferred; single-trace inspect provides debugging ability with much less surface area.
- Observability vs cost: omit full route-level tokenized cost breakdown in alpha; provide route-level cost estimates only.

Review feedback:
- Eng (Santiago Patel): implement pre-aggregator as separate lambda to avoid coupling with serving runtime.
- Design (Riya Kapoor): compact cards must be keyboard-accessible and have clear degrade state when data is stale.
- Security (Arjun Patel): confirm all telemetry goes through KMS redaction path; use redwood-kms-alpha key.

Links and artifacts:
- PRD: https://confluence.redwood/Console/Onramp-Alpha-PRD
- Design mocks: https://drive.redwood/company/console/onramp-design-v1
- Engineering spike notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/1285
- Acceptance checklist Google Sheet: https://sheets.redwood/company/console/onramp-alpha-checklist
acceptance_criteria: Cardset ships as three responsive cards: CostSummary, TopLatencyRoutes, SingleTraceInspect
CostSummary shows hourly aggregated cost delta, 7d trend sparkline, and top-3 contributing routes
TopLatencyRoutes lists routes with p50/p95 latency and traffic percentage with link to SingleTraceInspect
SingleTraceInspect opens a discrete trace view for a selected trace id; view must render start/end timestamps, span tree (collapsed by default), and a link to raw trace JSON
All telemetry is routed through the KMS redaction path and PII fields removed per Legal checklist
Stale-data UI state visible when pre-aggregator failure or >2 hour lag
E2E smoke tests validating datums appear in UI using the alpha pre-aggregator fixture
Performance: Console page initial render <= 750ms for alpha dataset in staging; card load for each after initial render <= 300ms
Rollout gating: feature flagged with correlated monitoring (error rate, card render failures) and can be toggled via admin when incidents detected
decisions: Defer: per-token cost breakdown and route heatmap — low alpha value, high infra cost
Adopt: hourly pre-aggregated cost tile instead of streaming cost events to Console
Adopt: single-trace inspect in place of search — reduces index and query surface for alpha
Implement: separate pre-aggregator service to reduce coupling with runtime and simplify rollback
Require: KMS redaction for telemetry before any Console storage
notes: If observability infra supports incremental rollout, we will expand TopLatencyRoutes to TopErrorRoutes in next cycle
Design asked for a very small visual affordance to explain 'why data is stale' — include microcopy and tooltip
QA to validate keyboard nav and screen-reader labels for three cards
Consider crediting Dedicated telemetry budget for alpha to avoid impacting hosted production metrics
